claim: The raw-count floor is retained, and promotion is additionally bound to attributable, independent, unambiguous evidence. Every change makes promotion harder; none weakens the floor.

implemented.attributability: mcp/servers/lib/aggregate-effectiveness.js NON_ATTRIBUTABLE_VERBS — echo, true, ls, cd, cat, pwd and similar cannot be promoted at all. Their zero exit says nothing about task achievement, and without this they accumulate a near-1.0 bound and outrank real work.
implemented.independence: The Wilson interval is computed over an EFFECTIVE sample deflated by observed correlation (distinct trajectories / raw observations). The RAW count still gates the floor exactly as before. A second floor requires evidence from >= RUVECTOR_AGGREGATE_MIN_TRAJECTORIES (default 3) distinct trajectories.
implemented.ambiguity: Only a CLEAN success counts toward the numerator (RUVECTOR_AGGREGATE_SUCCESS_QUALITY, default 0.9). A zero-exit command that wrote to stderr is graded 0.85 by the recorder — real but ambiguous evidence — so it stays in the denominator and leaves the numerator, and is counted separately as n_ambiguous.
implemented.staleness: Evidence older than RUVECTOR_AGGREGATE_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 90) is excluded outright, because recency decay never reaches zero and a pattern last seen a year ago would otherwise stay eligible on its raw count.
implemented.transparency: Each aggregate carries n_trajectories, n_distinct_commands, n_ambiguous, independence and wilson_uncorrected alongside wilson, so the cost of the correction is visible rather than hidden inside one number. summariseGates reports patterns_withheld by reason, so 'nothing promoted' is a diagnosis.

measured.worked_example: 40 observations at a 100% success rate: from ONE trajectory the bound falls from 0.9124 (uncorrected) to 0.2065 and promotion is refused as insufficient-independent-trajectories; from 20 trajectories it is 0.8389 and promoted. An `echo` pattern with 99 observations across 30 trajectories is refused as non-attributable regardless of its numbers.

covers: the RAW-count floor is retained unchanged (I06)
40 CORRELATED observations from one trajectory are refused
correlation WIDENS the interval instead of narrowing it, at an identical success proportion
a misleading zero-exit verb can never be promoted, however good its numbers
genuinely independent attributable evidence IS promoted
ambiguous stderr-noisy successes stay out of the numerator
stale evidence is excluded by an explicit window, not just decayed
replayed persistence is idempotent: identical input gives identical output
summariseGates reports WHY patterns were withheld

remaining: Independence is approximated by distinct trajectories. Two trajectories driven by the same agent on the same task are still counted as independent.
Attributability is a verb allowlist, not a measurement of task achievement. A `cargo build` that succeeds while producing the wrong artefact still counts as a clean success.
The corrected bounds have not been applied to the live aggregate corpus: doing so requires a sweep run, which writes.
